### [Can the world even afford an AI apocalypse?](https://mb.com.ph/2026/09/18/can-the-world-even-afford-an-ai-apocalypse){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}

19 September 2026 · *Manila Bulletin*

::: {.calculated-excerpt}
The lever is not merely unaffordable; under the present AI paradigm, it may not
yet exist. Smaller models that run locally remain useful, and a new architecture
may offer a better path. What remains doubtful is whether today’s large language
models can become superintelligent simply by feeding them ever more chips,
electricity, and capital.

[Read more](https://mb.com.ph/2026/09/18/can-the-world-even-afford-an-ai-apocalypse){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm .calculated-read-more target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::

### [Injecting more diskarte into the diploma](https://mb.com.ph/2026/09/12/injecting-more-diskarte-into-the-diploma){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}

12 September 2026 · *Manila Bulletin*

::: {.calculated-excerpt}
Does entering adulthood really have to involve this much guesswork? We often
say education prepares students for life. Perhaps that preparation can include
practical matters such as opening a bank account, reading a payslip, dealing
with government agencies, and starting a small business.

[Read more](https://mb.com.ph/2026/09/12/injecting-more-diskarte-into-the-diploma){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm .calculated-read-more target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::

### [There's something about Alex](https://mb.com.ph/2026/09/05/theres-something-about-alex){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}

5 September 2026 · *Manila Bulletin*

::: {.calculated-excerpt}
Alex(andra Eala) seems remarkably composed through all of it. She speaks carefully about
representing the Philippines and about staying herself despite the attention.
Frankly, I find that a little embarrassing. I did not have that kind of
self-awareness at her age. I am not sure I had it even much later, when I
already had an audience of my own.

[Read more](https://mb.com.ph/2026/09/05/theres-something-about-alex){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm .calculated-read-more target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
